topic: Calibration updates for specific inventory category
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on updating calibration values for a specific inventory category (Mall_telt200) belonging to company 7897.

Initial requests included changing the calibration for this category across all facilities, with one instance requiring a specific value of 74. Later, an update was requested for all facilities associated with company 7897 and category Mall_telt200, specifically adding +2 to the previous calibration value.

The final action involved migrating the completed calibration updates from staging to production.
decisions: Calibration values were updated for Mall_telt200 across facilities belonging to company 7897.
The updated calibration was successfully moved from staging to production.
